description: Add a block (a repeatable piece inside a section: a link, a photo, a testimonial, …) of a `type` the section accepts (get_site.theme.sections[type].blocks). Nest it in another block with parent_block_id. An outside image url in an image setting is copied into the business's media library and the setting stores our copy; if it can't be downloaded the call fails with image_fetch_failed and nothing changes.

page_id.description: Page id, e.g. home, menu, about, loyalty

parent_block_id.description: Nest inside this block instead of the section

preset.description: Start from one of the block type's presets

settings.description: Settings as a JSON merge patch (null removes a key). get_site lists each type's settings.

type.description: Block type the section accepts (see get_site)

name: add_block
title: Add block
